header.purpose: Anomalies of the repository's own Missions that the reality check pins by name. Authored by hand; no value here is generated. Each named entry must still be present and behave as stated (a subset check); an anomaly that is not named is printed by the check and is never a failure, because an archived Mission cannot be edited and a new Mission may legitimately add one.
header.paths: A Mission is its directory name under kitty-specs; a path is relative to that directory.

no_prompt_file.why: its file name has no slug, so it is no prompt file: artifactReferences.prompt is null and the listing kind is other

duplicate_work_package_ids.why: each id is held by two files; the first file in byte order is the work package

refused_missions.why: a legacy lanes.json with feature_slug and no mission_slug: the product's own reader refuses it, so every work package answers 500
